_comment: Recorded Grok answers for the golden claim, so the demo runs with the network off. They pass the same code checks as a live answer. Run with a key to call Grok live instead.

read_claim.raw_notes: Retailer counted 10,560 against 10,800 on the DESADV; reservation written on the DDT at unloading

verdict.summary: The signed DDT carries a reservation for one missing pallet of 240 packs, and the invoice bills the 10,800 on the DESADV. Credit 240 x 2.20.

points.text: The retailer signed the DDT with a reservation: 10,560 received of 10,800 shipped, one pallet missing
Invoice FT-2026/0001 bills 10,800 packs at 2.20, the quantity on the DESADV
Playbook shortage rule: proof of delivery beats the despatch advice when the reservation was written at unloading

deduction_verdict.summary: The contract has no clause for flyer contributions: the promo annex RS-PROMO-AUT26 only sets a Basmati price. Ask Esselunga to repay the 300.00 deducted from FT-2026/0001.

points.text: No clause in the supply agreement allows a promotional contribution deduction

source.detail: promo annex RS-PROMO-AUT26 covers Basmati prices only

points.text: Invoice FT-2026/0001 was issued for the 10,800 packs shipped, matched to the DESADV
